title: FatPipe MPVPN and Constellation: The “Pipe” Connecting Network Resilience and Visibility
summary: Complementing this resilience, FatPipe Constellation extends network visibility beyond the WAN edge and into the broader infrastructure.
body_markdown:
For school districts managing multiple locations, improving LAN/WAN visibility and asset monitoring needs to be practical and cost-effective.[FatPipe Constellation](https://www.fatpipeinc.com/products/fatpipe-constellation) gives IT teams a centralized platform to monitor switches, routers, firewalls, servers, access points, and other connected infrastructure across multiple locations, without the cost and complexity of traditional enterprise monitoring platforms.


FatPipe[MPVPN](https://www.fatpipeinc.com/products/mpvpn) provides the foundation for resilient WAN connectivity. Its hardware-based network edge platform combines multiple WAN connections to support intelligent traffic distribution, secure connectivity, and automatic failover. By using multiple connections, organizations can maintain network availability while making better use of their existing bandwidth.


**FatPipe Constellation Working with FatPipe MPVPN**


Complementing this resilience, FatPipe Constellation extends network visibility beyond the WAN edge and into the broader infrastructure. Through SNMP, flow-based monitoring, and device telemetry, Constellation helps administrators[monitor](https://www.fatpipeinc.com/products/fatpipe-total-security-360) interface status, bandwidth utilization, CPU and memory usage, and device health. Network utilization insights show traffic volumes and performance conditions across links, devices, and locations.


The combination offers a practical advantage: MPVPN helps keep traffic moving, while Constellation helps administrators understand the infrastructure supporting that connectivity. Network visualization and mapping provide a clear picture of connected assets and their relationships, making distributed environments easier to oversee.


**A Look at FatPipe Constellation**


Constellation can help IT teams:


- Automatically discover network devices, track additions and removals, and manage assets.
- Monitor device availability, CPU and memory usage, interfaces, ports, SFPs, fans, batteries, and connectivity.
- Use predefined standard OIDs or customize OID selection, with free setup.
- View network topology and relationships between connected devices.
- Identify outages and infrastructure issues faster through a centralized dashboard.
- Use a locally hosted service for faster response and lower costs, with an AWS version also available.
- Manage configuration changes.
- Connect to commonly used platforms through webhooks.


**Simpler Network Troubleshooting**


Constellation simplifies network investigations through IP and MAC address lookups, along with access to ARP tables and forwarding databases. These capabilities help administrators identify devices, understand address relationships, and trace connectivity without repeatedly accessing individual devices.


For school districts, distributed enterprises, and other organizations managing geographically dispersed infrastructure, FatPipe MPVPN and Constellation address two essential priorities: keeping networks connected and maintaining visibility into their operations. Together, they help IT teams reduce operational complexity, troubleshoot more effectively, and make more informed infrastructure decisions.
